subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT an example of a public sector industry in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tata Iron and Steel Company**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​__Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO) is not an example of a public sector industry in India. \
 
• TISCO is a privately owned company
 
• Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO), now known as Tata Steel, is one of the oldest and largest steel manufacturing companies in India
 
• Founded: 1907 by Jamsetji Tata, a visionary industrialist.
 
• Headquarters: Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC)
 
• A public sector enterprise under the Government of India.
 
• Engaged in power generation and allied activities.
 
• Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL)
 
• A public sector enterprise owned by the Government of India.
 
• One of the largest steel-making companies in India.
 
• Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL)
 
• A public sector undertaking (PSU) under the Ministry of Heavy Industries.
 
• Specializes in manufacturing electrical equipment.
